title: 移除交易脈動預設畫面的內部成交量碼並收斂提醒

acceptance_1_clean_fill_rate_and_quantit.summary: TradingPulsePage renders each verified fill ratio once in human language in both zh-TW and en-US without printing a duplicate raw line ({num}/{den} {unitInfo.raw}). Known share/lot/contract units (SHARES/shares/share/股, lots/張, contracts/口) render with their verified localized unit, while internal telemetry machine codes such as absolute_order_quantity or unspecified/unknown unit tokens render with a neutral localized quantity unit (zh-TW: 單位, en-US: units) instead of leaking raw machine strings or guessing shares. Verifiable 1/1 (100%) and 0/452 (0%) numerators/denominators are preserved, and unknown/unavailable/stale fill rates are never fabricated.

acceptance_2_notable_events_filtering_an.summary: Verified normal full-fill Personas (such as 青禾 2330 1/1 and 衡岳 0050 1/1) that have no pre-broker rejection, no capital shortfall, and no actionable reason code (only null or reason_not_recorded) are excluded from Notable Trading Events (TradingPulseNotableEventsSection) and never rendered as routine green Reason-not-recorded alert cards. They remain in the Persona Trading Details table (TradingPulsePersonaDetailsSection) with their verified metrics, Persona detail links (preserving contextual return state), and latest Trade Journey links, showing noAbnormalEvents in the recent event cell. The historical 澄川 2317 pre-broker risk rejection (0/452, insufficient_cash, submitted_to_broker=false) remains highlighted in Notable Trading Events and navigates to the exact scoped Trade Journey with return roundtrip. Additionally, when verified trading sources are healthy and paper_runtime_monitoring is the sole degraded leaf surface, the operator scope summary displays a concise localized monitoring notice rather than implying trading data is missing or stale.

acceptance_3_bilingual_regressions_and_c.summary: Added bilingual (zh-TW and en-US) regression tests covering the real hosted 1/1 and 0/452 absolute_order_quantity wire shape with two normal full-fill Personas, one pre-broker rejection, and paper_runtime_monitoring-only surface degradation while preserving all existing narrow-viewport, PersonaDetail header return, and Trade Journey roundtrip tests. No acceptance scripts, BFF code, deployment scripts, or trading logic were modified.

runtime_budget.notes: Frontend UI rendering logic, i18n locale dictionary strings, and unit test coverage only; no recurring jobs, background emitters, or persistent writers added.
